name: Fog Cloud
description:
Choose a point within long range. You create a cloud of fog extending in a sphere out to short range from the chosen point, which lasts for 1 minute. Check a Condition.

Creatures cannot see more than 15 ft through the cloud. Within the cloud, attack rolls are ill-favored and damage rolls for melee attacks take -1d. If the Condition you checked was Troubled or Insecure, the cloud is difficult terrain.

Wind moves the cloud, as determined by the GM.

Describe the fog.
